25:1: Exalted is He who sent down the Furqan upon His servant that he may be a warner to the worlds.
25:2: He for whom is the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and He has not taken a child, and there is no partner for Him in sovereignty, and He created everything, then determined it with a determination.
25:3: They have taken deities besides Him that create nothing, while they themselves are created, and they possess neither harm nor benefit for themselves, and they possess neither death nor life nor resurrection.
25:4: Those who disbelieve said: 'This is nothing but a slander that he fabricated, and another people helped him with it.' Thus they have come with injustice and falsehood.
25:5: And they said: 'Tales of the ancients, he had them written down; so they are recited to him morning and evening.'
25:6: Say: 'The One who knows the secret of the heavens and the earth sent it down. Indeed, He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.'
25:7: They said: 'What kind of messenger is this that eats food and walks in the marketplaces? If only an angel were sent down to him so that he would be a warner with him!'
25:8: Or a treasure were cast to him, or he had a garden from which he could eat. The wrongdoers say: 'You follow none but a bewitched man.'
25:9: Look how they put forth examples for you, so they went astray, and now they cannot find a way.
25:10: Exalted is He who, if He wills, will make for you better than this: gardens beneath which rivers flow, and will make palaces for you.
25:11: No, they denied the Hour, and We have prepared a blazing fire for those who deny the Hour.
25:12: When it sees them from a distant place, they hear its raging and roaring.
25:13: When they are thrown into a narrow place with their hands bound to their necks, they pray there for destruction.
25:14: Do not pray today for one destruction; pray for many destructions.
25:15: Say: 'Is this better, or the Garden of Eternity promised to the righteous? It was a reward and a destination for them.'
25:16: There is for them therein whatever they wish, abiding eternally. It was a promise bound upon your Rabb, to be requested.
25:17: And the day He gathers them and what they worship besides Allah, He will say: 'Did you mislead these servants of Mine, or did they themselves stray from the way?'
25:18: They said: 'Glory be to You, it was not fitting for us to take allies besides You, but You provided enjoyment for them and their fathers until they forgot the Dhikr and became a ruined people.'
25:19: Indeed, they have denied you in what you say, so you can neither avert the punishment nor find help; and whoever among you does wrong, We will make him taste a great punishment.
25:20: And the messengers We sent before you also only ate food and walked in the marketplaces. We have made you a fitnah (test) for one another. Are you patient? And your Rabb is All-Seeing of everything.
25:21: And those who do not expect to meet Us said: 'Why are angels not sent down to us, or we should see our Rabb?' By Allah, they grew arrogant within themselves and exceeded with great insolence.
25:22: The day they see the angels, that day there is no good news for the criminals, and they will say: 'A forbidden ban!'
25:23: And We turned to whatever deed they did and made it scattered dust.
25:24: The companions of Paradise on that day are better in abode and more beautiful in resting place.
25:25: On that day the sky will split open with clouds, and the angels will be sent down in descent.
25:26: On that day sovereignty truly belongs to the Rahman, and this day is a very difficult day for the disbelievers.
25:27: And that day the wrongdoer will bite his hands, saying: 'Oh, I wish I had taken a path with the Messenger!'
25:28: Woe to me! I wish I had not taken so-and-so as a friend.
25:29: By Allah, he led me astray from the Dhikr after it had come to me. And Satan has always been a great betrayer of man.
25:30: And the Messenger said: 'My Rabb, indeed my people have taken this Quran as an abandoned thing.'
25:31: And thus We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals, and your Rabb is sufficient as a guide and a helper.
25:32: Those who disbelieve said: 'Why was the Quran not sent down to him all at once?' Thus, so that We may strengthen your heart with it, and We recited it in tertil (measured recitation).
25:33: And they do not come to you with an example but that We bring you the truth and a better explanation.
25:34: Those who are gathered upon their faces to Hell, those are worst in place and most astray in path.
25:35: And certainly We gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron with him as a minister.
25:36: And We said: 'Go to the people who denied Our verses.' Then We destroyed them completely.
25:37: And the people of Noah, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made them a sign for mankind, and We prepared a painful punishment for the wrongdoers.
25:38: And 'Ad, Thamud, the people of al-Rass, and many generations between them, We also destroyed.
25:39: To each We gave examples, and each We ruined completely.
25:40: And certainly they came upon the town upon which was rained the rain of disaster. Did they not see it? No, they did not expect resurrection.
25:41: When they see you, they take you only as mockery: 'Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?' they say.
25:42: 'He would almost have led us astray from our deities if we had not been steadfast to them,' they say. When they see the punishment, they will know who is more astray in path.
25:43: Have you seen the one who took his desire as his deity? Will you be a guardian over him?
25:44: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are only like cattle; on the contrary, they are further astray in path.
25:45: Have you not seen how your Rabb extended the shadow? If He had willed, He would surely have made it stationary. Then We made the sun an evidence for it.
25:46: Then We drew it to Ourselves with a gradual withdrawal.
25:47: He who made the night a covering for you, sleep a rest, and the day a time for dispersal.
25:48: And He who sent the winds as heralds of good news before His mercy, and We sent down pure water from the sky.
25:49: That We may give life to a dead land with it and give drink to many cattle and humans We created.
25:50: And certainly We distributed it among them so that they might take heed, but most of the people refused except ungratefulness.
25:51: If We had willed, We would have sent a warner to every town.
25:52: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it with a great jihad.
25:53: He is the One who released the two seas: this one sweet, fresh water, and this one salty, bitter water; and He placed between them a barzakh and a forbidden barrier.
25:54: He created a human being from water and made him a bond of lineage and a bond of marriage. Your Rabb is Capable.
25:55: And they worship besides Allah what neither benefits them nor harms them. The disbeliever is a backer against his Rabb.
25:56: And We did not send you except as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
25:57: Say: 'I do not ask of you any reward for it, except whoever wishes to take a path to his Rabb.'
25:58: Put your trust in the Living One who does not die, and glorify Him with praise, and it is sufficient that He is aware of the sins of His servants.
25:59: He who created the heavens and the earth and that which is between the two in six days, then istawa upon the Throne is ar-Rahman; ask about this one who is aware.
25:60: And when it is said to them, 'Prostrate to ar-Rahman,' they said, 'And what is ar-Rahman? Are we to prostrate to what you command us?' and this increased their turning away.
25:61: Blessed is the One who created constellations in the sky and created therein a radiant lamp and an illuminating moon.
25:62: He made the night and the day in succession for those who wish to remember or wish to give thanks.
25:63: The servants of ar-Rahman walk upon the earth with humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, 'Peace.'
25:64: And those who spend the night for their Rabb, prostrating and standing.
25:65: And those who say: 'Our Rabb, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is a continuous punishment.'
25:66: Indeed, it is an evil resting place and an evil place of residence.
25:67: And those who, when they spend, neither waste nor are stingy, and between that is a moderate conduct.
25:68: And those who do not supplicate to another deity along with Allah, and do not kill the soul that Allah has made forbidden without right, and do not commit adultery. And whoever does this will find a sin.
25:69: On the Day of Resurrection the punishment is multiplied for him, and he remains therein humiliated forever.
25:70: Except those who repent, believe, and do righteous deeds; so Allah changes their evil deeds into good deeds.
25:71: Whoever repents and does righteous deeds, indeed he turns to Allah with a true repentance.
25:72: And those who do not bear witness to falsehood, and when they encounter vain talk, they pass by nobly.
25:73: And those who, when the verses of their Rabb are reminded to them, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
25:74: And those who say: 'Our Rabb, grant us from our spouses and our offspring comfort of the eyes, and make us leaders for those of taqwa.'
25:75: Those are rewarded with the highest station of Paradise for their patience, and they are met therein with greeting and peace.
25:76: They are eternal dwellers therein; how excellent a place of settlement and how excellent a resting place!
25:77: Say: 'What value would my Rabb give to you were it not for your supplication? You have indeed denied, so it will soon be binding.'
